name: Alther's Mill

angles.text: Rebuilding the infrastructure of Lakeshire is vital for the Kingdom of Stormwind, but constant threats keep pulling resources away from the bridge.

faq.answer: Foreman Oslow is the stonemason and overseer in charge of repairing and rebuilding the bridge in Lakeshire. He is constantly plagued by local threats delaying his construction efforts.
Alther's Mill is a lumber mill located east of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. It supplies crucial lumber shipments needed for construction projects around Lakeshire, including the bridge.

Alther is the proprietor or operator of the lumber mill east of Lakeshire. According to Foreman Oslow, Alther is responsible for managing the site, though an infestation of spiders has currently overtaken his mill.

Foreman Oslow cannot safely send workers to collect essential lumber shipments while tarantulas infest the mill. Clearing the spiders and destroying their eggs ensures the mill can safely resume supply deliveries for the bridge construction.
faq.q: Why does Foreman Oslow need Alther's Mill cleared?

faq.answer: Greater tarantulas have infested the mill grounds along with clutches of spider eggs, posing a severe threat to any workers sent to retrieve lumber.
Foreman Oslow is working to rebuild the bridge in Lakeshire, but his timeline is repeatedly stalled by hostile orcs, gnolls, murlocs, and resource shortages caused by local pests.
faq.q: What bridge is Foreman Oslow trying to build?

sections.body: Foreman Oslow has his hands full attempting to keep bridge repairs on schedule in Lakeshire. Between hostile Blackrock orcs, encroaching gnoll packs, and aggressive murlocs along Lake Everstill, his workforce is pushed to the limit. The latest disruption strikes directly at his supply chain: Alther's Mill, the lumber operation to the east, has been overrun by giant tarantulas, halting timber shipments needed for the town's bridge.
sections.title: A Bottleneck in Lumber

sections.body: The lumber mill sits as good as useless while spiders lurk among the timber stacks. Foreman Oslow cannot risk sending his laborers into a nest of greater tarantulas, prompting him to hire capable adventurers to clear out the arachnids and destroy their egg clutches. Though Oslow is irritated that Alther allowed the mill to fall into such disarray, restoring the flow of lumber takes precedence over any grievances.
sections.title: Clearing the Infestation

summary: Alther's Mill is a Redridge Mountains quest given by Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire. The foreman needs adventurers to clear out a dangerous tarantula infestation at the nearby lumber mill so workers can safely retrieve the timber required to finish the Lakeshire bridge.
